svg.aria-label: Isometric drawing: a laptop on the left creates a virtual display, encodes it, and sends frames through an encrypted gate along a link to a decoder, which shows them full screen on an old iMac. OpenAirDisplay lets an old Mac act as a 4K external display.
svg.text: Use any old Mac as a 4K
iMac 2015+ · wired or wireless · native resolution
Free, open source, no account, no dongle. MCP ready.
